name: A turn that finally works after failed checks is a hard-won finish
case: The agent's tests fail twice early in a long turn; it keeps at it until they pass, and the turn finishes done ten minutes in. That's hard-won: Boop plays the finish as a success in a proud face (or an excited or happy one), glad, held long, three or four times.
why: PERSONALITY's Examples: a long turn done after failed checks is a success in a proud face, held four times; the finish's line says its failed checks (after 2 failed checks); react.loops: the biggest moments are a hard-won finish
